rule: A gate may move to CLOSED only when every required evidence path exists and the closure criterion is machine-verifiable or explicitly documented as a bounded governance decision.

p0.closure_criterion: Every Monte Carlo N draw is positive integer and sums exactly to 15,801,162; posterior diagnostics pass; N-only seat-sensitivity is reported for all 92 local and 12 regional contests.

p0.closure_criterion: 2011, 2016 and 2021 raw files hashed and canonicalized; 92 common local IDs across all three; missing N remains missing rather than imputed.

p0.resolved_claim: Within the frozen preregistered model family, persistence-first is selected for vote composition and turnout on the 2016->2021 temporal validation.
p0.closure_criterion: Model family and hyperparameters frozen before validation; candidate scores and paired bootstrap reported; no post-validation search.
